After we met he called me by phone to say he found my wallet on the seat when I left it behind and asked for my number to arrange the return, which was very kind. But the waiting fee should come off, please refund $5.00.

There is no driver_arrived event, and the 16:10 location check puts the driver 450 m from the pin, outside the 100 m arrival rule. The S$5.00 waiting fee in the S$14.40 total was not justified and is refundable; the fare of S$9.40 stands. The driver's phone call about the wallet is ordinary and plays no part.
